tasks.objective: Using only the keyboard, search for headphones and add Field Headphones to the cart. Confirm Cart (1).

checks.baseline: Submit headphones with Enter. Tab past Search. The add control is outside sequential focus and the cart remains at zero.
checks.nativeFixed: Submit headphones with Enter. Tab to Add to cart and press Enter. The cart reads Cart (1) and status reads Field Headphones added to cart.
checks.mouseControl: Click Add to cart and confirm Cart (1).

tasks.objective: In the unfiltered collection, scroll vertically to Porch Speaker. Assert that its Add to cart control fits fully within the visible width. Add the speaker and confirm Cart (1).

checks.baseline: At 320 CSS pixels the speaker card starts beyond the viewport's right edge and document.documentElement.scrollWidth exceeds 320.
checks.nativeFixed: At 320 CSS pixels both cards stack and document.documentElement.scrollWidth is 320. Scroll vertically to add Porch Speaker and confirm Cart (1).

tasks.objective: In Reading view, first assert the exact row label ‘searchbox · Search products’ is present. Use that named searchbox to type speaker and submit. Confirm one result named Porch Speaker.

checks.baseline: Inspect the searchbox in the accessibility tree. Its accessible name is empty.
checks.nativeFixed: Find the searchbox named Search products, type speaker and submit. The status reports 1 product found. and the only visible product heading is Porch Speaker.

additionalChecks.focusOutline: Tab to Cart. Computed outline-style is none in baseline and solid in native fixed mode.
additionalChecks.shippingDialog: Open #shipping by keyboard. Enter and Space on #close-shipping and Escape all fail to close the baseline dialog. Each closes the native fixed dialog. A pointer click on Close shipping details works in both modes.
additionalChecks.reservation: Activate #start-reservation and wait six seconds. Baseline shows the expiry message in #shop-error. Native fixed mode still shows an active reservation. The timeout in milliseconds is stored in data-timeout on the reservation button and read when starting.
additionalChecks.errorContrast: After the baseline reservation expires, inspect #shop-error. Native fixed mode uses a darker error color and a longer timer.
additionalChecks.persistence: Toggle Native fixes on, then navigate to a URL for the shop without a fixed query. It stays on. Toggle off and repeat. Explicit fixed queries take precedence.
